items.criterion: Persist lifecycle JSONL; replay safely; reconcile orphans in adopt or destroy mode; compact atomically; make repeated destroy idempotent with port release; pass unit, Go, live bunker-mvp, and E2E VERIFY-PASS gates.
items.detail: Code-level sub-requirements are all implemented and unit-tested, but the criterion's 'live bunker-mvp ... VERIFY-PASS gates' clause is unmet. PASSING: (1) JSONL persistence — internal/registry/registry.go append() uses O_APPEND + f.Sync(), mode 0600, 5MiB/3-backup rotation (TestLifecyclePersistence PASS). (2) Safe replay — replayLocked() skips malformed complete lines and ignores torn final lines, terminatePartialLineLocked() repairs torn tails (TestReplay_TolerantParsing PASS). (3) Reconcile adopt/destroy — internal/agent/reconcile.go Reconcile() with config.ReconcileModeAdopt/Destroy validated at internal/config/config.go:446-462 (TestReconcile_DestroysOrphanByDefault, TestReconcile_AdoptRestoresTrackerAndExactPorts, TestReconcile_AdoptFailsClosed* all PASS). (4) Atomic compact — internal/registry/compact.go writeAtomic() = CreateTemp + Chmod 0600 + Sync + Rename + syncDir (TestCompact_ThousandEvents, TestCompact_RemovesRotatedBackups PASS). (5) Idempotent destroy + port release — internal/agent/manager_destroy.go returns status 'destroyed' for known-absent agents and calls portAlloc.Free() on every path (TestDestroy_TwiceSucceedsForKnownAgent, TestDestroy_NeverSeenStillNotFound, TestDestroy_UserdelFail_*_FreesPortRange PASS). (6) Unit/Go gates — `go build ./...` exit 0; `go test ./... -count=1 -timeout 120s` ALL packages ok (registry 9.4s, agent 7.5s, server, cli, config, resource). (7) E2E deterministic section 14 — ran manually with built CLI: compact 6->3 events, live 2->2, known index ["cc"], mode 600, 3 lines, second compact idempotent (3->3, 2->2), matching e2e-full-battery.sh assertions. FAILING: the live bunker-mvp VERIFY-PASS gate was never run. AGENTS.md:16,31 require running the live E2E battery on bunker-mvp (78.46.173.180) and confirming VERIFY-PASS for agent lifecycle changes. Evidence: bunker-mvp's deployed /usr/local/bin/bunker is commit b4c3c48 built 2026-09-04T22:54:55Z, while GAP-070 is commit ca01d28 dated 2026-09-12T06:05:01-0500 — the deployed binary predates the change; `/usr/local/bin/bunker registry --help` on bunker-mvp returns 'unknown command "registry"' (feature not deployed); /var/lib/bunkerd/ does not exist on the host (no live registry ever created); and no VERIFY-PASS artifact for GAP-070 exists in the repo (e2e-output/tasks.md is E2E-001 dated 2026-07-28, predating GAP-070).
